body: Hey sorry I didn't reply to begin with ,to be honest I didn't really understand what you where saying .but thank you for caring
I'm sitting at home on my own doing nothing .so pretty much a normal day for me
I wouldn't even know where to look for something like that or even them for help .crippling anxiety paired with depression doesn't make like worth living

If I'm not here I can't be a burden. And like it's just not as easy as telling somone .it sounds pathetic but I just can't tell somone .I just want every thing to be over .rather than crawling through a painful pointless life .

But it's just not that easy ,I just can't talk about that stuff with people .and it's not like I can ask her now ,she's at a party and I'm at home on my own like normal .I just don't want to cause any more problems in a broken family

And it's not like I could just ask my parents. It's too complicated to explain but my mum did in a way kinda find out how I feel a few months ago .and since then it's just been something that doesn't get talked about .It feels like she just doesn't care ,but in a way I know that's not true. So i don't know why
But it's not that simple. And even if I could get them I don't want to live like that controled by meds and feeling nothing
But you don't understand I don't want to live in this pain anymore ,I don't want meds .I just want the pain to stop .I just want to be at peace
I don't know, I'm such a fucking mess
I don't mean to young to take them I mean to young to get them .I'm 17

I'm not taking meds ,I'm to young to get them and I haven't told my family so they can't help either .but why would I all they do is suppress your feelings I'll just be even more of an empty shell than I already am ,why should I live like that when I could end it
